Privacy Policy

How this website handles your information, cookies and analytics.

Last updated: 3 October 2026

This privacy policy explains how this website (“we”, “us”) handles information when you visit it. It covers this website only. The Teen Patti Pro app has its own terms and privacy policy, which you will see inside the app.

Information we collect

  • Usage data: if analytics is enabled, we collect anonymous information such as pages viewed, device type, browser and approximate location to understand how the site is used.
  • Messages: if you email us, we receive your email address and whatever you include in your message.

We do not ask for, and do not want, your banking details, passwords or OTPs. We will never contact you to ask for them.

Cookies

We may use cookies or similar technologies for analytics. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings; the site will still work.

How we use information

  • To run and improve this website.
  • To reply to your questions.
  • To keep the site secure and prevent abuse.

We do not sell your personal information.

Third-party services

This site may use third-party services such as hosting providers, Google Fonts and analytics tools, which process data under their own privacy policies. Links to other websites are not covered by this policy.

Children

This website is intended for adults aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect information from children.

Contact

Questions about this policy? Email support@theteenpattipro.com.
